bx-d.label: IPL debutants for LSG, 2008–2024
bx-d.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
bx-d.filters: First IPL season with the franchise
bx-d.query: SELECT pl.name, CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (13) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END x, i.batting_team_id bt, i.bowling_team_id wt, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.batter_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 GROUP BY pl.name, year, bt UNION ALL SELECT pl.name, CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, 0, i.bowling_team_id, i.bowling_team_id, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 GROUP BY pl.name, year, i.bowling_team_id
